actions: Isolate the suspicious gNB/eNodeB via OSS with immediate RAN segmentation rules.
Enforce NAS security mode command (SMC) with mandatory integrity protection (128-bit keys).
Deploy NAS trace filtering to block IMSI attachment requests without valid authentication.
Update NEF/AMF to reject NAS_EPS_EMM_CAUSE=125 without prior NAS security context.
Enable 5G NAS replay attack detection with a 30-second timestamp window.
Configure RAN to enforce NAS message integrity checks for all NAS_EPS_EMM messages.
Set NAS security mode command failure counter threshold at 5 consecutive failures.
Deploy NAS message rate limiting (10 requests/minute per UE) via AMF policies.
Enable NAS protocol conformance testing for all gNB/eNodeB deployments.
Audit NAS security configuration for missing NAS security mode command enforcement.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
Cross Check Between Application Layer And Transport Layer
